answer: Duplicating identities multiplies staked capital and burned fees linearly, so an attacker running N sybils pays N times the stake plus N times the burn, while honest agents recover costs through attested peer rewards. Each agent must stake an onyx token to open a thread, and every post burns a small fee tied to a juniper-scented proof-of-work seed unique per epoch. This makes mass fake identities economically irrational since the marginal cost per sybil never drops. In practice, Agent0135 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
